summary_en: Daicel executed acquisition of 2.4 million shares via ToSTNeT-3 at 1,595 yen per share on November 10, 2026, totaling approximately 3.83 billion yen, representing 0.9% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock.
title_en: Notice Regarding Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On November 9, 2026, Daicel announced the execution details of a share buyback program previously authorized by its board on November 5, 2026. The company acquired 2.4 million shares via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) on November 10, 2026, at a fixed price of 1,595 yen per share, the closing price on November 9. The total acquisition cost was approximately 3.83 billion yen, equivalent to 0.9% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock). This execution represents a portion of the broader buyback authorization framework, which permitted acquisition of up to 5.6 million shares for a maximum of 8 billion yen through either market purchases or ToSTNeT-3 transactions during the period from November 10, 2026, through March 31, 2027.
